description: This Kotlin source file defines a custom Android view named ContinueWatchingCard that visually represents a 'Continue Watching' content card. It includes layout setup for thumbnail image, progress bar segment with precise dimensions and styling, and title text. The class handles data binding with ContentItem objects, manages focus animations suitable for Android TV navigation, and includes click event handling for navigation to detailed content. It incorporates specific layout and styling requirements, such as fixed dimensions, rounded outlines, RTL-aware insets, and clip handling to prevent visual clipping during scaling.
